module.title: DHCP server checks
module.description: CheckDHCP checks a Windows DHCP Server: the address utilisation of every IPv4 scope (through the DHCP Server Management API) and the server's packet statistics (through the DHCP Server performance counters).
module.name: CheckDHCP

commands.check_dhcp_scopes: Check the address utilisation of the IPv4 scopes on a DHCP server (addresses in use, free and offered, percent used). Windows only.
commands.check_dhcp_server: Check the DHCP server's packet statistics (discovers, offers, requests, acks, nacks, declines per second and queue lengths). Windows only.
